changes.description: Clarified that its CC-BY-4.0 field applies to the cited manuscript/content work.
Added a component-level SPDX map and clarified the CFF license scope.
Clarified component licensing and limited the local embedding description to helper code rather than an executable condition.
Separated 350 total retrievals from 100 gated retrievals and displayed both supported gate-call means.

Narrowed scope-bleed to a deterministic pattern observation; qualified machine-only and within-scenario results; documented the unreconciled round/call accounting; added the existing repository DOI; and limited the embedding claim to helper code and a planned condition.
Recorded that the release check does not establish historical metadata conformance to the current schema.
Described the six scenarios as one hand-authored pilot demonstration per proposed mechanism, not evidence of prevalence or general mitigation efficacy.

evidence_used: The frozen report's 350 total retrievals, 135 gate calls, and 0.3857 all-retrieval mean, together with the manuscript's 100 gated retrievals and 1.35 gated-retrieval mean.
The CB-VAL-003 manifest's enabled judge and the frozen CB-VAL-003 null judge records, plus the documented permit-delays pattern behavior on byte-identical prompts.
The manuscript's stated nine scenarios, seven configurations, five repetitions, 350 recorded rounds, 52 recorded review rounds, and 660 claimed calls.
The existing repository DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22859806 and the existing component license statements.
The documented TF-IDF-only retrieval path and local embedding helper/planned condition.
The existing pilot limitations concerning one hand-authored scenario per mechanism, unresolved machine-only results, and single-run v0.2 observations.
claims_modified: The scope-bleed 4/5 versus 0/5 comparison is described as a deterministic within-scenario pattern observation, not a validated response-contamination effect.
The taxonomy is described as a conceptual framework operationalized in one hand-authored pilot scenario per mechanism, not as empirical validation of general mechanisms or mitigation efficacy.
The learned-embedding description is restricted to helper code and a planned successor condition.
The 350-round and 660-call figures are described as unreconciled frozen-report claims rather than recomputable audit totals.
notes: ACTION-001 requires either the exact historical CB-VAL-003 manifest or regenerated frozen verdicts; neither can be created from the supplied evidence without changing frozen evidence or inventing provenance.

ACTIONS-004 and -005 require version-specific archive objects, commit SHAs, and artifact hashes that are not present. A repository-level DOI was added where requested, but it does not establish release-specific contents.

ACTION-006 cannot be fully reconciled from supplied evidence: the declared 9 x 7 x 5 design implies 315 rounds, while the frozen report records 350; no tenth scenario or corresponding call log is supplied.
ACTION-008 requires implementation/version, prompt-template, vectorizer, ranking, and memory-serialization details absent from the artifact.
ACTION-012 requires the missing bibliography source or a rendered archival paper; neither is supplied.
ACTION-023 requires a historical schema version or an append-only metadata correction with explicit schema version; the available run metadata cannot be expanded with absent values.
The supplied workspace contains the v0.3 report and verdict files, so the premise of ACTION-021 that no aggregate evidence is supplied does not hold for this repair workspace.
